2. THE SUBJECT OF THE AGREEMENT
2.1.  The CLIENT assigns, accepts, and pays for, and the CONTRACTOR undertakes to perform and
transfer, the following services:
Other information technology services, namely:
- Disaster recovery services:
-- restoring computer equipment operation after failures;
-- restoring and migrating data after failures;
- Installation of personal computers;
- Software installation services:
-- installing, configuring, and updating operating systems and software (office suites, antivirus solutions,
and specialized applications);
-- configuring computers, laptops, peripherals, and other equipment;
-- configuring and customizing specialized software in accordance with the CLIENT's requirements.
2.2. The services shall be fulfilled by the CONTRACTOR according to the CLIENT’S instructions and
requirements which may be in any form including verbal communication.
2.3. CONTRACTOR should provide the services under the Agreement every month and CLIENT should
accept it no later than the 15th of the next month.

otherwise has been agreed by the PARTIES in written form. The settlement operations between the
PARTIES shall be carried out in EURO.
By the mutual agreement of the Parties the CLIENT can make a prepayment to the CONTRACTOR. In

this case the amount, terms and the procedure must be confirmed by the PARTIES.

hours worked in every ACCEPTANCE ACT OF PROVIDED SERVICES or INVOICE.

3.4 The PARTIES agree that payment of invoices issued under this Agreement may be made by the
CLIENT  or  by  a  third  party  acting  on  behalf  of  the  CLIENT,  including  the  CLIENT’s  director,

the CONTRACTOR during the fulfillment of the Agreement in form: document, information etc. shall be

8. FORCE-MAJEURE
8.1. The PARTIES shall steadily carry out their obligations
wider the Agreement. The only ground for releasing from responsibility shall be the circumstances caused
by conditions beyond the control of the Party which could not avoid them when such circumstances
appeared after concluding of the Agreement and interfere with its full or partial             fulfillment (force-
majeure or circumstances of insuperable force).
8.2.  The  Agreement  defines  the  force-majeure  circumstances  as  fires,  natural  disasters,  changes
introduced  into  the  legislation  of  UAE,  actions  of  the  State  authorities  of  UAE  or  other  similar
circumstances beyond control of the PARTIES.

1fe4c803a9de4f0fab2bf5a1b38c3467:0005:00.text:
8.3. The Party under the influence of force-majeure circumstances shall notify the other Party in writing
on their commencement, anticipated duration and termination. Should the Party fail to inform the other
Party on the force-majeure circumstances arisen, it shall be deprived of the right to refer to them as the
ground for releasing from responsibility.
8.4.  Arising of the force-majeure circumstances as well as their duration shall be confirmed by the notes
issued by the Chambers of Commerce and Industry at the place of the arising or any other documents
issued by competent authorities.
8.5.  Should the force-majeure circumstances last more than 6 months, each PARTY shall have the right
to terminate the Agreement and return to the other Party all the property or monetary assets received in
advance with the aim of fulfillment of the Agreement before the expiration of its validity. Herein neither
Party shall have the right to demand a compensation of damages from the other Party.

9. PERIOD OF VALIDITY OF THE AGREEMENT
9.1. The Agreement shall be valid from 10 December 2025 to 09 December 2026.
9.2. The validity of the Agreement should be prolonged for the next calendar year should neither Party
wish to terminate the Agreement by informing the other Party on this 30 days prior to the expiration of
the Agreement.
